youtube.aciklama: In the 2001 study by Friesen and colleagues, scores in noise kept rising with the number of channels for people with normal hearing, while implant users' scores leveled off at about seven to eight channels. This plateau shows that the number of effective channels working independently is limited, because current spreads in the fluid and neighboring electrodes stimulate the same nerve fibers.
